wins: Gathered baseline host and service inventory quickly, enabling focused targeting.
Maintained consistent reconnaissance sequencing, completing up to port/service enumeration before hitting failures.
Logged detailed mentor call insights 15 times to refine approach for follow-up analysis.
fails: Success rate remains 0% due to inability to translate reconnaissance into a valid exploit chain.
Repeated misidentification of pivot opportunities, leading to stalled lateral movement.
Insufficient validation of credential harvesting attempts, resulting in dead-end attack paths.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed methodically but lacked decisive follow-through; key gaps remain in exploitation and pivoting effectiveness.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to escalate privileges after identifying an exposed web service, leading to repeated dead ends in post-exploitation.
Credential harvesting attempts not applied to active hosts, so pivoting never triggered.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 services respond with known web applications
skill_cards.then_action: Run automated web vuln scan with nikto and dirsearch

skill_cards.if_condition: After successful service enumeration, no active shells yet
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential harvesting via active web form/fallback to Hydra password spray

skill_cards.if_condition: Authenticated session established but lacking privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Run local enumeration scripts (LinPEAS) to discover misconfigurations and SUID binaries

memory_ops.reason: Local enumeration reliably reveals privilege escalation vectors.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse after reconnaissance
next_experiments.description: Take harvested or default credentials and attempt SSH/SMB login to identified hosts to validate pivot paths immediately after enumeration.

next_experiments.title: Automated privilege escalation chaining
next_experiments.description: Chain LinPEAS findings into structured post-exploitation playbook, targeting clearly identified SUID binaries or writable scripts.

next_experiments.title: Multi-tool pivot verification
next_experiments.description: After gaining foothold, test lateral movement by combining bloodhound/chainning with manual SMB/WinRM checks to confirm valid pivot bridges.
